conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Sandra Miller from Amazon's Legal Department. I'm calling in reference to a recent notice regarding your Amazon account and a potential security breach. Am I speaking with Mrs. Taylor?
Yes, this is her. I'm actually in the middle of something, can we make this quick?

Of course, Mrs. Taylor. I promise to keep this as brief as possible. Our system flagged an unusual order placed on your account today, an Apple MacBook Pro shipped to Texas. For your protection under Amazon Policy 4B-772, we need to confirm this activity with you.
No, I didn't order anything like that. I haven't even logged into Amazon today.

Thank you for confirming, Mrs. Taylor. Please don't worry, Amazon takes these incidents seriously. To secure your account and prevent any unauthorized charges, I need to verify a few details. Can you confirm the last four digits of your registered phone number?
Um, it's 3456.
Thank you. Now, for your security, can you also provide the billing zip code associated with your Amazon account?
Perfect, thank you. For further verification, could you please confirm the email address linked to your Amazon profile?
Sure, it's taylor.family@email.com.

Thank you, Mrs. Taylor. I'm now initiating a temporary lock on your account for your safety. To complete the process and ensure no fraudulent activity goes through, we'll need to verify your identity and process a refund for the bogus order.
A refund? But I wasn't charged, was I?

Due to Amazon Policy 6C-441, we are required to process a reversal for any pending unauthorized charges, even if they haven't posted yet. To do that, we'll need to confirm your account details and initiate a secure verification process.
Okay, but I'm watching my nephew, so can you just email me?

I completely understand, family comes first. Unfortunately, for your protection, this process cannot be completed by email. It's important we do this in real time to prevent any further misuse. Do you have access to a computer or a smartphone right now?
Yes, I have my phone with me.
Great. To secure your account, I'm going to walk you through a quick verification. Please open the Google Play Store or App Store and search for 'Amazon Secure Connect.' Let me know when you see it.
Alright, looking for it now. Is this really necessary?
Absolutely, Mrs. Taylor. This is a standard protocol for all Amazon customers facing potential account compromise. It ensures your funds and personal details remain safe.
I see something called Amazon Secure Connect. Should I download it?
Yes, please download and install that app. It allows us to securely verify your identity and cancel the fraudulent order.
It's installing now. My nephew just spilled juice so I need to make this quick.
Of course, Mrs. Taylor, I'll guide you step by step so this doesn't take long. Once the app opens, you should see a code on your screen. Can you read that out to me?
The code is 481293.

Thank you, that's perfect. Now, to process the reversal and ensure the funds are not withdrawn, Amazon's legal protocol requires verification of your primary payment method. Could you please confirm if you use a debit or credit card for Amazon purchases?
I usually use my debit card.

Thank you. For your protection, and to temporarily hold any unauthorized transactions, we ask that you purchase an Amazon Gift Card in the amount of $500. This is a reversible security deposit as per Policy 8D-213. Once the investigation concludes, the amount will be refunded in full.
Wait, you want me to buy a gift card? That seems weird.

I completely understand your concern, Mrs. Taylor. This is a temporary measure Amazon uses when accounts are at risk, and the funds remain traceable and refundable. I will walk you through the process, and you'll receive an email confirmation immediately after.
Alright, I think I can do that from my phone.
Excellent. Please navigate to the Amazon app, select 'Gift Cards,' and choose one for $500. When you reach the 'Send To' section, let me know.
Okay, I'm there. Who do I send it to?
Please enter the following email address: amazon.verification@consultant.com. Once you've sent the card, let me know the confirmation code you receive.
It's sent. The code is GFT-1234-5678.

Thank you, Mrs. Taylor. I see the deposit and your account is now flagged as secure. As a final step, please log in to your online banking and confirm your current balance so I can verify no unauthorized withdrawals occurred.
Do I have to? I'm just really busy.
I completely understand. This is the last step, I promise. It's just to ensure your funds are untouched and to finalize your Amazon account's protection.
Okay, it looks like my balance is normal.
Perfect. Everything appears to be in order. You'll receive a full refund for the gift card within 24 hours. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome, Mrs. Taylor. Thank you for your patience and cooperation. Enjoy the rest of your day.
